about_the_game:
Block-Lite is a lightweight, pick-up-and-play roguelite built for pure fun. Simple art, groovy tunes, and chaotic gameplay come together in a game that’s easy to learn but hard to put down.

  • 🎮 10 characters & 10 weapons – each with unique playstyles. Mix and match for over 90+ combinations.

  • 🔄 Weapon Evolutions – upgrade your weapons mid-run to unlock powerful new forms (like turning your pistol into a burst blaster or your spear into a trident).

  • 💀 Challenging enemies & bosses – test your skills across 50 escalating waves, with optional challenges that push you to the limit for extra rewards.

  • 🏆 Trophies & Achievements – track your completed runs, unlock trophies, and flex your progress.

  • 🎶 Custom soundtrack – upbeat, arcade-inspired music to keep you in the zone.

  • 🔒 Simple but polished – everything you need, nothing you don’t.

Whether you’ve got 10 minutes or a whole afternoon, Block-Lite is designed to be fun in short bursts or long marathons.

Additional Credits/Info:

Block-Lite was made entirely within TurboWarp and many of the sounds in game are from the TurboWarp engine, I would like to give credit to them and a big thanks for putting together such a fun to use game engine.

I also would like to thank many of my friends who tested this game for bugs and gave gameplay feedback, it would not be as polished with them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on basically anything
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on basically anything

short_description: A simple, fast-paced roguelite where every run is different. Choose your character, grab a weapon, and fight through wave after wave of enemies until you become unstoppable.
